title: Re-qualify F1-F11
status_note: Describes what happened (Law 3): H2 was NOT started. No worktree was created, no agent was dispatched, no probe was run. This is a hold, not a partial result, and nothing in this receipt should be read as evidence about F1-F11.

hold_reason.instruction: STOP. The delta is the finding. Re-scope H1 to diagnose it and hold H2/H3.

measurement_that_triggered_it.shipping: cannot collect - 3 collection errors, 0 tests run; forced past: 4707 passed / 117 failed (hython 3.13.10)

hold_reason.orchestrator_reasoning: H2's entire method is re-probing F1-F11 against 22.0.368 and then mutation-testing the existing regression pins. Both halves are measured ON the shipping interpreter. That interpreter cannot currently collect the suite, and roughly 35 of its 117 failures are mock-hou/Qt-stub tests asserting against fakes rather than the host. Running H2 now would re-qualify eleven findings using an instrument that is itself under repair - which is the precise failure this harness was built to stop. Nothing is repaired before it can be measured.

what_H2_would_have_done.work: assayer re-probes each of F1-F11 against 22.0.368 returning CONFIRMED | REFUTED | UNVERIFIABLE with a file:line anchor; seam-hunter then mutation-tests every existing regression pin, breaking each implementation deliberately and confirming the pin fails.
what_H2_would_have_done.premise: F4's premise is REFUTED-LIVE. One in eleven was a phantom, repaired with a green test that could not fail. The other ten share its provenance and have not been individually re-probed.

carried_forward_evidence.note: Q1 independently demonstrated the H2 method works and finds real decorations. Three pins were mutation-tested there; one earlier pin was found to survive two of four mutations (the __file__ filter mutation SLIPPED entirely) and was strengthened rather than accepted. That is direct evidence that H2's premise is sound and that it should run - just not against a broken instrument.

Q2 bucket 2 is an H2-shaped finding surfaced early: a planted fake hou appears to beat the REAL hou inside the shipping interpreter, affecting ~17 tests. If confirmed, every live-Houdini assertion on the shipping path is suspect, which materially expands H2's scope beyond F1-F11.

for_ruling.question: Confirm the hold, and confirm the release condition.
for_ruling.proposed_release_condition: H2 unblocks when the shipping interpreter can COLLECT the suite (0 collection errors) and the fake-hou residency question from Q2 bucket 2 is resolved. It does NOT require the shipping suite to be fully green - only interpretable.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I - a sequencing judgement between defensible options. The alternative reading is that H2 is a static re-probe and could proceed on the gate interpreter alone; I rejected that because F1-F11 are host-behaviour claims and Law 1 bans asserting those against a mock. That is a judgement, so it is escalated rather than taken.

for_ruling.question: Does H2's scope expand to cover the ~17 tests in Q2 bucket 2?
for_ruling.context: If a fake hou is winning over a real hou on the shipping path, those tests are decorations in exactly F4's sense, and they are not among F1-F11.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Scope change to a defined leg.

resume_token.next: Do not start H2 until the release condition in H2-R1 is ruled and met. When it starts: git worktree add -b feat/repair-requalify .claude/worktrees/repair-requalify <pinned SHA>, cherry-pick AGENT_CONSTITUTION.md and CTO_RULINGS_01.md (R38 - note both were already present by descent in this run's worktrees, verify rather than assume), dispatch assayer then seam-hunter under harness/relay-settings.json.
